meta.why: Removed from the country file: web-checked and confirmed not to be published documents — synthesised meta/framing nodes, geographic areas, industries, projects, institutions. Banned by data spec 2b/2c. Kept here in full so nothing is lost.

reports.title: Central Bank of Myanmar institutional and reporting core
reports.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, foreign-exchange management and key macro-financial and external statistics. Publishes monetary, banking, exchange-rate, BOP and related series where available.

reports.title: Myanmar foundational statistical-system meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from CSO and CBM sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding the CSO institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, CBM institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Myanmar research.
reports._notes: Opening integrating node for Myanmar research. Data quality and coverage constraints should be carried forward in subsequent batches.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch

reports.title: Myanmar agriculture–extractives–China densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from agricultural, energy and trade sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding agriculture and rice statistics, natural gas production/exports, and Myanmar–China trade into a coherent primary-sector, extractives and external layer under constrained data conditions.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
National accounts, CPI, BOP and CBM series from Batch 1

reports.title: Jade and gemstone production / export framing
reports.publisher: Derived from trade and sector sources
reports.description: Framing and available statistics on jade and gemstone production and exports. Jade has historically been a major foreign-exchange and informal-economy activity, with strong China-linked demand and limited transparency.
reports._notes: High-centrality informal and extractive densification. Data quality is particularly limited.

reports.title: Myanmar poverty–exchange–jade densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from welfare, CBM and extractives sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding poverty and living-standards statistics, exchange-rate/parallel-market statistics, and jade/gemstone framing into a coherent welfare–monetary–extractive layer under constrained conditions.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
CPI, BOP, gas and China trade series from earlier batches

reports.title: Myanmar labour–fiscal–border densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from labour, fiscal and trade sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding labour force statistics, fiscal balance/deficit indicators, and border trade framing into a coherent labour–fiscal–trade layer under constrained conditions.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Poverty, CPI, China trade and BOP series from earlier batches

reports.title: Myanmar displacement–minerals–education densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from humanitarian, mineral and education sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding internal displacement and humanitarian needs, rare earths/critical minerals framing, and education/learning outcomes into a coherent humanitarian–extractive–human-capital residual layer under constrained conditions.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Poverty, labour, China trade and extractives series from earlier batches

findings.title: Central Bank of Myanmar institutional and reporting core
findings.finding: Not a publication - this is an institutional node for the Central Bank of Myanmar itself; additionally cbm.gov.mm, forex.cbm.gov.mm and cbm.gov.mm/content/* are all domain unreachable via WebFetch (robots.txt returns HTTP 503).

findings.title: Jade and gemstone production / export framing
findings.finding: No official jade/gemstone production or export series could be retrieved: myanmargems.gov.mm does not resolve and monrec.gov.mm is domain unreachable via WebFetch; the Ministry of Commerce commodity tables aggregate jade into 'mining products' with no separate line. Largely a synthesised framing node.
